description: This file defines interface functions and external variables for uCode script handling within the hostapd project, including VM creation, execution, registration management, and debugging utilities.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_create_vm
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new uCode virtual machine instance.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a uCode function call by name.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call
methods.description: Calls a uCode function with specified number of arguments.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_free_vm
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the uCode VM.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_global_init
methods.description: Initializes a global variable or resource within the uCode environment.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the registry at a specified index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the registry by index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the registry by index.

methods.name: uc_wpa_udebug_set
methods.description: Sets debugging parameters for uCode VM.

methods.name: uc_wpa_getpid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID within uCode context.
